alignmentRules.sourceFramedRule: SkinAnalyzer.calculateAlignmentFromLandmarks sourceFramed (face width >= 0.28, chin y <= 0.88, forehead y >= 0.12)
alignmentRules.yawAngleThresholds: FRONT: |yaw| <= 0.20, RIGHT: -0.65 <= yaw <= -0.28, LEFT: 0.28 <= yaw <= 0.65 (dimensionless ratio: (nose.x - eyeMidX) / (eyeDist * 0.8))

multiAngleScopeEnforcement.frontCapture: Measures forehead, nose, chin, periorbital, rightCheek, leftCheek
multiAngleScopeEnforcement.rightCapture: Measures STRICTLY leftCheek (exposed). Occluded rightCheek is out-of-scope.
multiAngleScopeEnforcement.leftCapture: Measures STRICTLY rightCheek (exposed). Occluded leftCheek is out-of-scope.
multiAngleScopeEnforcement.outOfPose: Images failing roll, pitch, yaw, or framing are OUT_OF_POSE; pimples categorized as OUT_OF_SCOPE_EXTREME_POSE.

productAcceptedPoses_53pimples.poseRequirements: FRONT (|yaw|<=0.20), RIGHT (-0.65<=yaw<=-0.28, only leftCheek), LEFT (0.28<=yaw<=0.65, only rightCheek); roll<=0.15 rad, pitch<=0.22, sourceFramed=True

strictCapturableGate_14pimples.gateRequirements: FRONT pozunda katı frontend snapshot kapısı (isAligned=True, yüzün çerçeveye tam oturması ve boyut sınırları)
strictCapturableGate_14pimples.reasonForDifference: Ürün kabulü alan 10 pozitif görselin 7si yan profil (RIGHT/LEFT) çekimidir. matchesSkinAngle sözleşmesine uymalarına rağmen katı ön profil snapshot gateini (isAligned) geçemezler. Bu nedenle capturable kapsamında yalnız 3 ön poz görseli ve 14 lezyon kalmaktadır.

filterComparisonSummary.description: Direct evaluation of isolated historical filter functions across 43 validation images at conf=0.70, nms=0.30

cpuBenchmark.epochThroughputReality: Actual full training step includes tile slicing, masked objectness BCE calculation, and PyTorch backward pass on CPU taking ~2406s (40.1 min) per epoch. Synthetic 5-step estimate was overly optimistic.
cpuBenchmark.budgetExecutionDecision: Trained exactly 1 epoch (~40.1 min) within interactive budget limits; transactional checkpoint saved and verified. Multi-epoch training requires dedicated GPU infrastructure.

fineTuningExperimentPhase1.interruptionReason: Stopped after Epoch 1 (2406.2s, 40.1 min) to respect interactive execution budget. Candidate weights and ONNX exported and verified.

bestModelSelected.reason: Hiçbir Phase 2 epochu başlangıç warm-start skorunu (0.34823) geçememiştir (bad_epochs=3, early stopped). Dosya sistemindeki Phase 2 candidate-selected.safetensors dosyası son epoch ağırlıklarını (epoch-03, b63d3f43...) taşımaktadır; ancak dürüst model seçimi kriterine göre deneyin gerçek en iyi modeli warm-start modelidir (Phase 1).

timeAccounting.note: Script toplam çalışma süresi (6474.5 s / 107.9 dk) saf eğitim CPU süresi değildir. Saf eğitim epoch süresi 2960.9 s (~49.3 dk), validasyon geçişleri ise 3513.6 s (~58.6 dk) sürmüştür.
